top_signals.headline: Bank Indonesia Holds BI-Rate at 5.75% to Support Rupiah Stability
top_signals.impact: The central bank maintained its benchmark rate amid global uncertainty, balancing growth support with currency stability. Foreign reserves remain robust at $151.8B, providing FX intervention capacity.

top_signals.headline: JCI Index Resilient Above 7,200 as Foreign Flows Turn Positive
top_signals.impact: Jakarta Composite Index maintains strength driven by banking and consumer sectors. Net foreign buying resumed as EM sentiment improves on Fed pivot expectations. YTD performance +2.3%.

top_signals.headline: Indonesia Q3 GDP Grows 5.12% YoY, Beats Consensus Estimates
top_signals.impact: Economic expansion driven by household consumption (+4.9%) and fixed investment (+5.1%). Manufacturing PMI at 52.3 signals continued expansion. Full-year growth projected at 5.05-5.15%.

top_signals.headline: Federal Reserve Signals Potential December Rate Cut Amid Cooling Inflation
top_signals.impact: FOMC minutes suggest committee members see conditions for further easing. Core PCE trending toward 2.5% target. Markets pricing 65% probability of 25bp cut in December.

top_signals.headline: Indonesian Rupiah Stabilizes at 15,850/USD on Trade Surplus
top_signals.impact: Currency finds support from continued trade surplus ($10.5B Q3) and BI intervention. Carry trade dynamics remain favorable vs USD. Key resistance at 16,000 level.

top_signals.headline: Indonesian Banks Report Strong NIM Expansion in Q3 Results
top_signals.impact: Major banks (BBCA, BBRI, BMRI) posted 12-15% earnings growth with NIMs expanding to 5.2-5.8%. Loan growth accelerated to 11.5% YoY. NPL ratios stable at 2.1-2.4%.

top_signals.headline: S&P 500 Approaches All-Time High on AI Optimism and Rate Cut Bets
top_signals.impact: Index trading near 6,000 level as tech sector leads. Magnificent 7 stocks contribute 60% of YTD gains. Earnings growth re-accelerating to +8% YoY in Q4.

top_signals.headline: US 10-Year Treasury Yield Falls to 4.35% on Dovish Fed Outlook
top_signals.impact: Bond yields decline as markets reprice Fed trajectory. Real yields at +2.0% remain attractive for fixed income allocations. Duration positioning shifts to neutral.

top_signals.headline: China Manufacturing PMI Expands to 51.5, Supporting EM Sentiment
top_signals.impact: Factory activity strengthens on stimulus measures and export recovery. Positive read-through for Asian supply chains and commodity demand. EM currencies rally.

top_signals.headline: Brent Crude Holds at $78/bbl as OPEC+ Maintains Production Discipline
top_signals.impact: Oil prices stabilize on balanced supply-demand outlook. OPEC+ compliance remains high at 95%. Inventory levels normalize. Range-bound trading expected near term.

top_signals.headline: Former CNN anchor Don Lemon arrested by feds over Minnesota activities, lawyer says
top_signals.impact: Lemon's "constitutionally protected work in Minneapolis was no different than what he has always done," his lawyer, Abbe Lowell, said.

top_signals.headline: Wholesale prices rise sharply and show new Fed chief could confront stubborn inflation
top_signals.impact: The cost of wholesale goods and services rose sharply at the end of last year, underscoring the battle against inflation is far from over as President Trump gets set to name a new chairman of the Federal Reserve.

top_signals.headline: GM is nailing the U.S. auto industry's profit, politics balancing act under Trump
top_signals.impact: GM's ability to walk such a tightrope has been easier to do when it can fall, if needed, onto $21.7 billion in cash to end 2025.

top_signals.headline: Microsoft’s Earnings Surge Is Overshadowed by Data-Center Spending
top_signals.impact: Higher-than-anticipated capital spending and slower growth in cloud computing weigh on shares

top_signals.headline: ServiceNow Q4 Earnings, Revenue Top Estimates Amid Acquisition Spree
top_signals.impact: ServiceNow reported Q4 earnings that topped estimates. The software maker forecast higher-than-expected subscription revenue growth for ServiceNow stock in 2026.

top_signals.headline: Prediction markets allow trading on Super Bowl commercials, prompting insider trading questions
top_signals.impact: Prediction markets Kalshi and Polymarket are offering trades on which companies will air Super Bowl ads, prompting concerns about potential insider trading.

top_signals.headline: Sandisk’s stock gets ‘one of the most delayed upgrades in history’ after blowout earnings
top_signals.impact: Analysts say Sandisk might wind up being sold out of storage products for years due to a widening gulf between supply and demand.

top_signals.headline: Exxon, Chevron are producing record amounts of oil, but lower prices led to lower earnings
top_signals.impact: The two U.S. integrated giants reported quarterly earnings with Venezuela in focus.

top_signals.headline: Ford to record $600 million pretax pension charge in fourth quarter
top_signals.impact: Ford will report a pretax charge of $600 million in its fourth quarter results due to adjustments to employee pension plans and other postretirement benefits.

top_signals.headline: Hollywood has an IP problem: Box office sales are banking on franchise hits that keep falling flat
top_signals.impact: But big-name installments like "Wicked: For Good" and "Avatar: Fire and Ash" have been underperforming ticket sales expectations.

top_signals.headline: Democratic states seek to hike taxes on the wealthy
top_signals.impact: Legislators and governors in blue states are preparing a range of new taxes on the wealthy. At the same time, many red states continue to cut or eliminate taxes.

top_signals.headline: New cars are increasingly becoming a luxury amid K-shaped economy concerns
top_signals.impact: The market has increasingly been pricing millions of Americans out of the new-vehicle market, including by cutting entry-level vehicle lines such as small cars.

top_signals.headline: Exxon, Chevron are producing oil at record rates, but lower prices led to lower earnings
top_signals.impact: The two U.S. integrated giants reported quarterly earnings with Venezuela in focus.

top_signals.headline: Gold’s searing run halted, silver briefly drops below $100 as Warsh to Fed hits dollar debasement trade
top_signals.impact: A selloff is underway for gold, silver and copper on Friday, as the dollar rises on expectations that Kevin Warsh will be the next Federal Reserve chairman.

top_signals.headline: SoFi’s stock rises as the company hits a revenue milestone
top_signals.impact: SoFi’s home-loan originations nearly doubled in the latest quarter.
